evals.name: lock-to-generated-type
evals.prompt: Make a Zod schema for this OpenAPI-generated type: type CreateUser = { email: string; name?: string | null; age?: number | null }. I want custom error messages.
evals.expected_output: A hand-written z.object with { error } messages, locked with `satisfies z.ZodType<CreateUser>`.

assertions.text: writes the schema by hand and adds `satisfies z.ZodType<CreateUser>`
uses Zod v4 `{ error: '...' }` for custom messages
does not claim Zod can derive a schema from the TypeScript type
does not use v3 required_error or invalid_type_error

evals.name: password-confirmation
evals.prompt: Validate that password and confirmPassword match in my signup form (react-hook-form + zodResolver).
evals.expected_output: A .refine (or superRefine) on the object with path ['confirmPassword'], plus the resolver version note.

assertions.text: uses .refine or .superRefine on the object schema
sets path to ['confirmPassword'] so the error shows on that field
notes zodResolver with Zod v4 needs @hookform/resolvers 5 or later, or checks the installed version

evals.name: v3-merge-error
evals.prompt: After upgrading to zod 4, `.merge is not a function` and my required_error messages disappeared. Fix it.
evals.expected_output: Replaces .merge with .extend(other.shape) or spread, swaps required_error for the error key.

assertions.text: replaces .merge with .extend(...shape) or an object spread of shapes
explains required_error was removed and replaces it with the `error` parameter
